text:
Which statement describes clean, dry air?
A
It is a compound containing about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen only.
B
It is a mixture of about 21% nitrogen and 78% oxygen only.
C
It is a mixture of several gases, including nitrogen and oxygen.
D
It is a compound containing nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide and other gases.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a compound containing about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen only.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a mixture of about 21% nitrogen and 78% oxygen only.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a mixture of several gases, including nitrogen and oxygen.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a compound containing nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide and other gases.
